brief.situation: You maintain blend.xlsx at Sunfield Growers Cooperative (fictional). It finds fractions a, b, c of three stock fertilizers that give the ordered nitrogen-phosphorus-potassium analysis, by inverting the 3 by 3 matrix of stock analyses. For a 15-5-10 order it returned amounts in the quadrillions, some negative. The plant needs the recipe at 10:00. It is 09:05.
handover: The fractions must add to 1 and none may be negative.

Each step takes working minutes, and the clock moves by the minutes it takes. The deadline runs on the same clock.
Shipping is final for this case. Afterwards you record what you found and explain your reasoning.

scoring.modelReasoning: Amounts in the quadrillions mean the matrix is singular. Stock A (10-10-10) is the average of B (20-0-10) and C (0-20-10), so the columns are dependent and the rank is 2. Row reduction shows the system is consistent with one free variable: a free, b = 0.75 - a/2, c = 0.25 - a/2, and nonnegativity gives 0 <= a <= 0.5. Cost falls as a rises, so 50% A and 50% B at $360/t. The minimum-norm solution is valid but costs more; clipping the noisy inverse misses the analysis.
